insurance_highlights.value: Trip Cancellation and Trip Interruption Insurance
insurance_highlights.quote: Protect your trip with cancellation and interruption insurance when you charge at least 75% of your trip costs to your card.
If you charge at least 75% of your ticket to your card, you’re eligible for reimbursement of necessary expenses if your flight is delayed up to $500 per insured person on the same trip.
If your checked luggage is delayed or lost, you’re covered up to $1,000 if you charged the full cost of your travel ticket to your card.
If your eligible rental car is damaged or stolen, you’re automatically insured if you’ve charged the full cost of it to your card.

When you use your card to pay for your stay at any hotel or motel around the world, you, your spouse, and your dependent children are eligible for coverage up to $1,000 against theft if your room is broken into.
When you charge at least 75% of your trip to your card, you’re insured against accidental loss of life or dismemberment up to $500,000 per insured person and up to $1,000,000 for the trip.
Most of the new items you buy with your card are insured against theft, loss, or damage for 90 days from the purchase date.
